title: chat-server: ChatBackend has no delegation; add a delegating wrapper or macro for wrapping MemoryBackend
description: chat-server: ChatBackend has no delegation; add a delegating wrapper or macro for wrapping MemoryBackend. Source: mimid session request 2026-11-19 (mimid-s2qc for embedding items).
notes:
2026-11-19: deferred for Mark's decision. ChatBackend has ~43 methods plus JmapBackend's 12, and MemoryBackend overrides many defaults, so a wrapper must forward nearly all to keep reference behaviour. Options: (a) a macro_rules delegate_chat_backend! that forwards every method to a field, with overrides written as a separate trait impl is not possible in Rust, so the macro would need an exclusion list; (b) split ChatBackend into smaller hook traits; (c) leave as is. Each adds maintenance in step with the trait.
Decision Mark 2026-11-19 (DECISIONS.md 37): split ChatBackend into smaller hook traits. Breaking. Next: design doc docs/design/chat-backend-split.md, then children.
2026-11-19: design draft docs/design/chat-backend-split.md committed; 4 open questions for Mark (names, ChatPolicy granularity, phase-2 delegates for shared traits, error types).
close_reason: Phase 1 done: 7353ae03 (split), Delegate* traits and test wrappers, docs. Phase 2 is JMAP-fmi6.
